color.description: The color to show, as a valid CSS color string. Its alpha is kept.

secondaryColor.description: A second color. With it the swatch shows a diagonal two-tone preview, and both colors keep their alpha. It needs a color.

shape.description: The swatch outline: `square` keeps the token-based corner radius, and `circle` is round.

colorName.description: One short phrase that names the whole preview in the application's language. Without one, a single color is named by its own description and a two-tone swatch by both descriptions.

disabled.description: Marks the swatch disabled. A disabled enclosing ColorPicker disables it too.

MuxUIColorValue.description: A CSS color string. A color control's onChange returns one in the color space of its value, of an enclosing ColorPicker's color, or of its defaultValue: rgba(r, g, b, a) for hex and rgb, hsla(h, s%, l%, a) for hsl and hsb. ColorSlider with colorSpace uses that space, and ColorSwatchPicker returns the chosen item's color.
